title: pane.send
description: Types text into a pane's program as it is, through the pane's input queue. Text over 4096 bytes is refused, not cut. A pane takes at most 20 sends a second: one more is refused as rate limited, as is a send when the pane's input queue is full. Needs hello version 2 and a caller pane. Another pane needs a window approval or live grant.

pane.description: The target pane. Another pane raises a keyboard-only window prompt showing this exact text.

text.description: At most 4096 bytes of UTF-8. It runs a command only if it carries the line end the program expects.
